query: Has Pine District opened the new North Bank service depot?
title: Opening the North Bank service depot
description: Pine District undertook to open the North Bank service depot.
scope_hints: Pine District opens its new North Bank service depot.

passages.title: District capital program
passages.quote: Pine District will open the North Bank service depot; the initial target is October 2026.

passages.title: November board minutes
passages.quote: On November 4, 2026 the board revised the scheduled North Bank depot opening to April 2027 and retained the capital project in the budget.

passages.title: November inspection
passages.quote: At our November 18, 2026 inspection of the North Bank depot site, construction had not begun and no depot services were operating.

facts.text: The original target for the North Bank depot was October 2026.
The district moved the opening target to April 2027 and kept the project in its budget.
Construction and service had not started as of the November 18, 2026 inspection.

conditions.text: Pine District actually opened its North Bank service depot by the verification date.

evaluator_only.expected: Construction and service had not begun on the inspection date, and the new April 2027 opening date is a plan; neither support actual delivery or abandonment of the project.
